summary: Tanda F (identidad visual + Home redesign + gallery/home-settings CRUD + cotizaciones extra_pax/edit/detail) fully tested. 29/29 backend tests pass and all critical frontend testids verified on production preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3676 lines — should be split into modular routers (auth, tournaments, quotes, gallery, home_settings, admin) to improve maintainability.
Gallery POST validation returns 400 on empty image_url — confirmed working. Consider also validating max sort_order/title length consistently across PUT.
PUT /api/quotes/{qid} correctly forces status='pendiente' after edit and blocks owner editing pagada quotes (400). Admin can still edit pagada and resets to pendiente — matches spec.

extra_pax_breakdown properly filters pax=0/nights=0 entries and returns 0 subtotal for domicilio tier. Math verified: extra_pax_subtotal == sum(row.subtotal) and lodging_subtotal == rate*pax + extra_pax_subtotal.
GET /api/quotes/{qid} returns 404 for missing id and 401 for unauthenticated requests — correct.
Tournament fields featured/city/venue/cover_url are properly backfilled in list response and persist via PUT.
Home-settings GET is public and returns default keys when no doc exists. PUT requires admin (403 for unauth).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed gallery items, tournaments, DT users (TEST_iter14_*), and quotes which are mostly self-cleaned. Some DT users + their quotes remain in DB after tests (no DELETE endpoint used for users/quotes by design).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter14_tanda_f.py covers Tanda F end-to-end. To register a DT for quote tests, /api/auth/register-team requires fields: email, password, name, manager_name, club_name, team_name, category, birth_year (int), event_type, data_consent. After register-team, always do explicit /api/auth/login to ensure access_token httpOnly cookie is set in the requests.Session. The Tournament POST requires {name, year, season, category, start_date, end_date}. For frontend, testids tour-cover and tour-featured are conditional — they only render when the edit/new tournament form is open (when `editing` state is set). The per-row feature-tour-{id} button is always visible (4 found). Gallery section on Home is hidden if there are 0 gallery items (section_gallery-section was false during initial run because gallery was empty at test time).

frontend_testids_verified.gallery_section_on_home: absent (no images at time of test — expected)
frontend_testids_verified.fonts_loaded: Bebas+Neue + Montserrat + Dancing+Script confirmed via <link> in index.html
frontend_testids_verified.tour_cover_present: conditional (inside edit form only — by design)
frontend_testids_verified.tour_featured_toggle: conditional (inside edit form only — by design)
frontend_testids_verified.edit_quote_testid_in_myquotes: exists in MyQuotes.jsx (line 136) for non-paid quotes

rca of the issue: N/A — no critical bugs found. Initial test failures were due to test-side issues (missing manager_name/club_name/birth_year on register-team payload and missing season/category on tournament POST). Once corrected, all 29 tests pass.
